test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: Six times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 25 years. After 10 years, four times Q's age will be 45 years less than nine times P's age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
solution:
**Given:**

P = present age of P = p years

Q = present age of Q = q years

6 times P exceeds Q by 25 years.

After 10 years, 4×(Q + 10) is 45 less than 9×(P + 10).

**Calculations:**

From first sentence:

⇒ 6p = q + 25

⇒ q = 6p - 25

From second sentence:

⇒ 4(q + 10) = 9(p + 10) - 45

Substitute q = 6p - 25:

⇒ 4(6p - 25 + 10) = 9(p + 10) - 45

⇒ 4(6p - 15) = 9p + 90 - 45

⇒ 24p - 60 = 9p + 45

⇒ 24p - 9p = 45 + 60

⇒ 15p = 105

⇒ p = 7

Now q = 6p - 25

⇒ q = 6×7 - 25

⇒ q = 42 - 25

⇒ q = 17

**Therefore the present age of Q = 17 years.**
